open_points.subject: create request replay after erasure or anonymisation
open_points.text: R0-36 says a create repeated after a lost answer “never silently makes a second project, customer or room”; A01 rule 8 says “A request id leaves its record with the values anonymisation or erasure removes ... a create arriving after that with the same request id is a new create.”
open_points.question: Must a request id remain reserved after project anonymisation/deletion or Customer erasure, or may a late replay create a second record?
options: Keep a permanent request-id tombstone and return or refuse the replay
Forget the request id and treat the replay as a new create
Keep tombstones only for some models or erasure modes
open_points.default_guess: Follow the later, specific A01 rule and treat it as a new create.

open_points.subject: failure precedence within one A04 stage
open_points.text: A04 rule 6 says “the first failure is its answer” but assigns multiple checks to each stage without ordering checks inside that stage, including “the values given (A02, A08, A22)” and “archived, erased, anonymised, not in the set, a customer's eligibility, a conflict.”
open_points.question: When two checks in the same stage fail, which refusal takes precedence?
options: Declare an order for every check within each stage
Return a combined validation failure
Permit implementation-defined precedence within a stage
open_points.default_guess: Use a fixed operation-specific order and return the first failure.

open_points.subject: owner sign-out scope
open_points.text: A13 says “Several owner sessions may be open at once” and that a session ends at “the owner's sign-out,” but does not say whether sign-out ends only the session carrying the request or every owner session.
open_points.question: Which owner sessions does one sign-out terminate?
options: Only the current owner session
All owner sessions in the instance
Let the sign-out action choose current or all
open_points.default_guess: End only the session carrying the sign-out request.

open_points.subject: expired pending confirmation submitted with a different value
open_points.text: A13 rule 6 says “an expired one is refused and cleared,” but later says a submission “giving another value, is refused and leaves the pending value as it was.”
open_points.question: If the pending confirmation has expired and the submission supplies a different value, is the expired pending confirmation cleared or retained?
options: Check expiry first and clear it
Check equality first and retain it on a different value
Clear expired confirmations independently before processing any request
open_points.default_guess: Clear the expired pending confirmation before comparing the submitted value.

open_points.subject: audit log order when recorded instants regress
open_points.text: State 0 requires audit entries “in time order,” while M09 and A15 make “the log's order ... the order of the numbers”; no rule requires entry instants to be nondecreasing when the system clock moves backward.
open_points.question: If a later sequence number has an earlier instant, which order is the audit log required to expose?
options: Sequence order is authoritative even when instants regress
Clamp or otherwise require audit instants to be nondecreasing
Sort by instant and use sequence only as a tie-breaker
open_points.default_guess: Treat sequence order as authoritative write order and allow displayed instants to regress.

open_points.subject: import with no selected projects
open_points.text: R0-79 permits “any subset” and A16 repeatedly refers to “the picks,” but neither says whether an empty set may be confirmed and create the migration closure.
open_points.question: May the owner successfully close the one-time import while selecting zero projects?
options: Refuse confirmation unless at least one project is selected
Accept it, write the closure and audit entry, and import nothing
Accept an empty selection without closing the import
open_points.default_guess: Refuse an empty selection so the irreversible closure cannot be created accidentally.

open_points.subject: import records that name rooms
open_points.text: A16 rule 4 calls a record malformed when “it names a project or room the file does not hold,” but the complete State 1 facts for Project, Room, Customer and ArtifactPointer define no imported record that names a room other than the Room record's own identity.
open_points.question: Which imported model and fact can reference a room, and what relationship is this validation meant to check?
options: The room-reference clause is inapplicable and should be removed
Artifact pointers or another imported record also carry a room reference
The phrase means only that a Room must name a project held by the file
open_points.default_guess: Interpret it as requiring each imported Room to name a held project and add no unmodelled room reference.

open_points.subject: service-token configuration test versus owner-only mode
open_points.text: A17 rule 1 permits “for an owner-only start, none of the four,” while required test 1 says “A configuration without Client Portal's token stops the start.”
open_points.question: Does the required test apply only to a partially populated service-token set, or should absence of Client Portal's token also reject owner-only mode?
options: Reject only partial token sets; all four or none remains valid
Always require Client Portal's token and remove owner-only mode
Use an explicit owner-only mode flag rather than inferring it from zero tokens
open_points.default_guess: Interpret the test as a partial-set test; exactly zero tokens remains valid.

open_points.subject: measurement and representation of 32-byte configuration secrets
open_points.text: A17 requires every secret to be “at least 32 bytes long,” but does not define whether configured secrets are raw bytes, UTF-8 text, hexadecimal text or base64 text, or which decoded value is compared.
open_points.question: What representation is accepted, and over which byte sequence are length, equality and constant-time comparison defined?
options: UTF-8 encode the configured text and measure those bytes
Require a fixed textual encoding and measure the decoded bytes
Treat configuration as raw binary secret values
open_points.default_guess: Require a declared base64 encoding and apply all checks to the decoded bytes.

open_points.subject: daily backup retry after a failed attempt
open_points.text: A18 says a missed run is made at startup “if no backup was made that UTC day” and that failed work “is tried again at the next run,” but also says “there is at most one run per UTC day.”
open_points.question: After today's scheduled attempt fails, may a restart or another trigger retry during the same UTC day?
options: Allow repeated attempts until one checked backup is kept
The first attempt consumes the day's run even when it fails
Permit only the post-import exceptional attempt in addition to the first daily attempt
open_points.default_guess: Allow same-day retries until one checked backup is kept, while limiting successful daily backups to one.

open_points.subject: failed removal of a leftover backup temporary file
open_points.text: A18 says “at every start and every run Registry first removes every temporary file left there,” and that a removal failure “is reported and tried again at the next run,” but does not say whether the current start or backup run continues after that failure.
open_points.question: Does failure to remove one stale temporary file abort startup, skip the current backup run, or allow the run to continue?
options: Abort startup
Keep serving but skip the current backup run
Continue the backup run using distinct temporary names
open_points.default_guess: Keep serving but skip the current backup run until cleanup succeeds.

open_points.subject: backup encryption and authentication construction
open_points.text: A18 requires that each backup “is encrypted with the backup key” and “cannot be read without the key,” but declares no encryption/authentication algorithm, nonce rule, key derivation or authenticated metadata.
open_points.question: What cryptographic construction makes backup confidentiality and tamper detection testable and interoperable across releases?
options: Declare an authenticated-encryption format and nonce-generation rule
Rely on a named backup library and pin its format by release
Permit each implementation or release to choose any encryption scheme
open_points.default_guess: Declare a versioned authenticated-encryption format using a standard AEAD construction with a unique random nonce per backup.

open_points.subject: ownership of files in the backup location
open_points.text: A18 requires Registry to delete “every backup” older than 30 days and “every temporary file left there,” but neither A17 nor A18 says the directory is dedicated to this Registry or defines how Registry distinguishes its files from unrelated files or another instance's backups.
open_points.question: Which files in the configured backup location may Registry inspect or delete?
options: Require a dedicated empty directory owned solely by this Registry
Manage only files carrying a validated Registry-specific name or header
Treat every file in the configured location as Registry-owned
open_points.default_guess: Manage only a Registry-specific namespace and never delete unknown files.

open_points.subject: uploaded import files held by other owner sessions after acceptance
open_points.text: Changed M11 says an uploaded import file is “dropped when the import is accepted,” while A16 rule 2 says “a file another session keeps stays until that session ends.”
open_points.question: When one session accepts the import, are uploaded import files in all other owner sessions dropped immediately or retained until those sessions end?
options: Drop every session's uploaded import file when the closure is committed
Drop only the accepting session's file and retain the others
Invalidate other files immediately but retain their bytes until session expiry
open_points.default_guess: Follow the more specific A16 rule: drop only the accepting session's file and retain each other session's file until that session ends.
